# Internacia Datasets

> Extended index for LLM agents and crawlers. Compact version: llms.txt
> Licensed CC-BY-4.0 (data). Code is MIT. Version: see data/datasets/*.manifest.json

## Summary

Reference data for countries (256), intergovernmental organizations / intblocks (1076), and blocktypes (86).
Designed for entity linking, geographic classification, and membership joins — NOT socioeconomic profiling.

## Agent entry points

- AGENTS.md — root routing hub (all platforms)
- AGENTS.zh.md — 中文智能体路由（Kimi、GLM、通义灵码）
- docs/agents/query.md — query and join workflow
- docs/agents/zh/query.md — 中文查询工作流
- docs/agents/contribute.md — YAML editing workflow
- docs/agents/openspec-quickstart.md — schema change proposals
- CLAUDE.md — Claude Code shim
- .github/copilot-instructions.md — GitHub Copilot shim

## Consumption

- docs/ai-consumers.md — full consumption contract, scope, field semantics
- docs/query-examples.md — verified DuckDB and Pandas recipes
- docs/country-code-policy.md — non-standard codes and filtering

## Data access

| Method | Location |
|--------|----------|
| DuckDB | data/datasets/internacia.duckdb |
| Parquet | data/datasets/{countries,intblocks,blocktypes}.parquet |
| JSONL (zstd) | data/datasets/{countries,intblocks,blocktypes}.jsonl.zst |
| Manifests | data/datasets/*.manifest.json |
| Aliases | data/datasets/intblocks_aliases.json |
| Python SDK | https://github.com/commondataio/internacia-python |
| REST API | https://github.com/commondataio/internacia-api |

## Join keys

- Countries: code (alpha-2), iso3code, wikidata_id
- Intblocks: id; membership via includes[].id → country code
- Blocktypes: id matches values in intblocks.blocktype

## Critical gotchas

- borders uses ISO alpha-3, not alpha-2
- population, area, gini are structs {value, year, source, source_id}
- Filter current ISO countries: code_status = 'official_iso3166_1' (249 records)
- Intblock id renames: check intblocks_aliases.json
- Out of scope: HDI, GDP, government type, internet penetration
